interfaces.name: Vpcc
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries Vdc, Vpcc, Icomp, Igrid and Iload. Vpcc must be one physically measured PCC phase voltage; Icomp, Igrid and Iload must each contain exactly the three physically measured phase currents. Use the same phase ordering for Icomp, Igrid and Iload; Vpcc must be the PCC phase voltage corresponding to channel 1 of those three current signals.

interfaces.name: Icomp
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries Vdc, Vpcc, Icomp, Igrid and Iload. Vpcc must be one physically measured PCC phase voltage; Icomp, Igrid and Iload must each contain exactly the three physically measured phase currents. Use the same phase ordering for Icomp, Igrid and Iload; Vpcc must be the PCC phase voltage corresponding to channel 1 of those three current signals. Define positive current from grid to PCC for Igrid, from PCC to load for Iload, and from PCC to converter for Icomp, so Igrid - Iload - Icomp must remain approximately zero at the PCC.
